data.long_meaning: Avarthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Avarthana', meaning 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Avarthi is considered the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted with coins, jewels, and other symbols of wealth. The name Avarthi carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avarthi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
